description: This file defines a custom Smarty plugin function 'sugar_link' that generates HTML anchor tags or URLs based on provided parameters, facilitating dynamic link creation within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_link
methods.description: Generates a hyperlink or URL based on parameters, supporting different modes such as link-only or full anchor HTML, and handles module-based URL construction with optional data and customization.
